description: Ship a UI surface where an operator can drop a fixture directory (TS source + expected-graph.json) and see the diff between expected and actual extraction. Mirrors `go-code-graph`'s P1 capability.

requirements.description: Ship a UI surface that allows an operator to provide a fixture directory containing TypeScript source files and an expected-graph.json, trigger an extraction, and view a structured diff between the expected and actual graphs. The diff must highlight added nodes, removed nodes, changed node properties (including leading_comments changes), added edges, and removed edges. This mirrors the equivalent capability in go-code-graph and serves as an interactive companion to the CI golden-fixture gate.
requirements.title: Fixture Validator UI for Expected vs Actual Graph Diffing

validation.notes: Test graph diff algorithm correctly identifies added nodes between two Graph structs
Test graph diff algorithm correctly identifies removed edges between two Graph structs
Test graph diff algorithm correctly identifies changed leading_comments on a node
Test diff rendering component highlights additions in green and removals in red
TCG-FIXTURE-VALIDATOR: Upload ts-jsdoc-tags fixture with a deliberately mutated expected-graph.json; UI shows diff highlighting the changed leading_comments field
Fixture validator UI triggers an Extract RPC call and receives a real graph for comparison
UI displays 'no differences found' when expected-graph.json matches actual extraction exactly
An operator can validate a new fixture and update expected-graph.json without running CLI commands
Diff output is sufficiently granular for a developer to identify which declaration's comment changed

title: Fixture Validator UI
